auditNotes: All accepted candidates are platform-native LinkedIn post objects, not profiles, search pages, comments, likes, reposts, or third-party coverage.
All accepted candidates have at least one directly visible positive engagement metric.
LinkedIn timestamps were deterministically derived from the native snowflake ID (ID >> 22) and emitted as UTC ISO-8601 values.
A public GitHub API sweep of verified company/founder accounts found no additional strict, company-related, net-new repository object for the low/zero-source set.
Ambiguous common-name YouTube/X search hits, partner posts, profile surfaces, and ownership-unproven accounts were rejected rather than promoted.
